title: The Last Harbor
author: Yara Delacroix
blurb: Astrid Winterbourne, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, has spent fifteen years learning which silences keep people safe. But when a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
